verdict.rationale: A community user reports that Fastmail can be set up to fetch mail from and send through Gmail like a mail client, which suggests some cross-provider aggregation. The docs only offer title-level pages on importing and migrating mail and on logging in to multiple accounts. None of these show ongoing work across several external providers from one place. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of external account fetching and sending, any evidence for Microsoft 365 or generic IMAP accounts, evidence of a unified multi-provider inbox, and hands-on detail beyond a single community comment.
